No Parking signs were originally post on the north side of the road, but some have been illegally removed.  If a sign was removed, stolen, or damaged, a driver lacks constructive notice of the restriction and cannot be ticketed. This has been a recurring issue on the road.  Residents park in the areas where No Parking signs have been removed and are never ticketed.

The new Yellow Springs Elementary School is causing massive traffic and chaos in the Tuscarora and Clover Ridge neighborhoods.  The new traffic circle to access the school entrance on Spring Run, is causing significant delays for citizens trying to exit the Tuscarora neighborhood.  There is only one way to leave the Tuscarora and combined Cannon Bluff neighborhoods to effectively enter the rest of Frederick.  This involves exiting Walter Martz Road going South.  An exit headed north on Walter Martz Road, would involve taking backroads to enter the rest of Frederick, that would add an additional 10 to 15 minutes of travel.  I highly recommend reassessing the current road structure on Walter Martz Road and adding an additional exit out of the Cannon Bluff and Tuscarora neighborhoods.  Thanks!
issues.address: 31 Rocky Springs Rd Frederick, MD, 21702, USA
